tasks.title: Digest the freebuff transcript into a continuity note
tasks.action: Summarise freebuff-chat-transcript.json (2026-09-10/11 session: vault setup, HF access, code audit, F-002, model download) into docs/PRIOR-CONTEXT.md: what was decided, what was left off, and how it connects to the current state. Keep it under 60 lines. Do not replay the transcript verbatim.
tasks.done_criterion: docs/PRIOR-CONTEXT.md exists, < 80 lines, references F-002 and the download stop point.

tasks.title: Pin dependencies to a lockfile
tasks.action: Freeze the working environment into code/requirements.lock (pip freeze against the SSD venv) and add pins for fastapi/uvicorn/pydantic/httpx. Document install step in docs/REPRODUCE.md §6. Do not upgrade packages.
tasks.done_criterion: code/requirements.lock is non-empty and contains pinned torch/transformers/fastapi lines.

tasks.title: Bring summary artifacts + checksums into the repo
tasks.action: Copy the SSD summary JSONs for EXP-A/B/C/D/E into code/results/summaries/ (small files only; no audio or weights) and write code/results/CHECKSUMS.sha256 over them. Update docs/REPRODUCE.md §12 item 2 to reflect that summaries are in-repo.
tasks.receipt: cd code/results && shasum -a 256 -c CHECKSUMS.sha256 >/dev/null && test -f summaries/exp-a-v1-summary.json && test -f summaries/exp-c-summary.json

tasks.title: Reconcile the EXP-D annotation-count discrepancy (P-11)
tasks.action: Determine why exp-d-semantic-curated-summary.json reports annotated_rows_scored=50 while REPORT.md/notes cite 11 number rows. Re-run score_exp_d_semantics.py on the curated annotations, record the true counts (number/date/currency/entity rows), and correct REPORT.md §5.4 and F-004 if needed. If the metric definition is ambiguous, state it explicitly.
tasks.done_criterion: A note in REPORT.md §5.4 saying 'Reconciled' with the corrected counts, and the summary artifact present with consistent counts.

tasks.title: Implement OI-WER and re-score EXP-A/C/D
tasks.action: Implement orthographically-informed WER (multi-reference + documented spelling/transliteration variants) in code/metrics/oi_wer.py with tests in code/tests/test_oi_wer.py. Re-score the cached EXP-A v1 baseline and EXP-C outputs; write summaries next to the originals with an 'oi_' prefix. Do not overwrite existing artifacts.
tasks.receipt: cd code && python3 -m pytest tests/test_oi_wer.py -q && test -f results/summaries/exp-a-v1-oiwer-summary.json
tasks.done_criterion: OI-WER tests pass and an OI-WER summary exists for EXP-A.

tasks.title: Bootstrap CIs + paired tests on cached results
tasks.action: Add a script that computes bootstrap 95% CIs for mean WER per language/condition and a paired test between baseline and oracle top-K (EXP-C) and between Core native and Flex mixed (EXP-D), from cached per-sample files. Output code/results/stats/bootstrap.json. Note small-n caveats.
tasks.receipt: test -s code/results/stats/bootstrap.json && python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('code/results/stats/bootstrap.json'));assert 'exp_c' in d and 'exp_d' in d"
tasks.done_criterion: bootstrap.json exists containing exp_c and exp_d entries.

tasks.title: Re-vendor Core/Flex code after the 2026-09-15 vendor update (P-12)
tasks.action: Re-download the current vendor code files (indic_transcribe.py, lid.py, long_form.py, inference.py, config/model files) to code/vendored/core/ and code/vendored/flex/ at a pinned revision, diff against the old snapshot 4d29eeb7a099, and record a summary in 40-pipeline/INFRA-NOTES.md and the model dossiers. Flag any code-level claim that changes.
tasks.done_criterion: New vendor files vendored, revision pinned, diff summarised in INFRA-NOTES.

tasks.title: Add a second ASR baseline for context
tasks.action: Score a second ASR baseline (vanilla nvidia/canary-1b-v2, or another Indic ASR) on the same 80-sample suite via the ASR service where available, and add a comparison column to REPORT.md §5.1/§6. Record model revision and decoding. This contextualises Core's 22.0% WER.
tasks.done_criterion: A second-baseline summary exists and REPORT.md mentions it.

tasks.title: Run EXP-F real-noise robustness
tasks.action: Execute the registered EXP-F (40-pipeline/experiments/EXP-F-real-noise.md): real market/call-center audio from kathbath/indicvoices short clips, matched against EXP-A synthetic-noise strata. Produce data/challenge/results/exp-f/ summary + per-sample records and record the falsifiable-target verdict in EXPERIMENT-OBSERVATIONS.
tasks.done_criterion: EXP-F summary exists with language/condition WER and the verdict recorded.

tasks.title: Rerun EXP-E with turn padding + a neural diarizer
tasks.action: Re-run EXP-E iteration 2 on the same 4 recordings plus a larger stratified subset: add turn padding/context and replace the toy VAD/KMeans with a neural diarizer and a published DER. Report whether padding rescues short turns and update F-003 accordingly (narrow the claim if it does).
tasks.done_criterion: EXP-E v2 summary exists and F-003 status updated.

tasks.title: Expand the challenge suite 80 -> 300-500
tasks.action: Expand the suite with real speakers and natural conditions to 300-500 rows using the existing materializers and degradation chain, keeping the paired clean/degraded design and provenance. Define a tune/holdout split. Rerun EXP-A and update the summary tables; do not overwrite the v1 artifacts.
tasks.done_criterion: v2 manifest has >= 300 rows and a tune/holdout split is recorded.

tasks.title: Human-verify the 19 flagged EXP-D rows (publication gate)
tasks.action: Present the 19 conservatively flagged EXP-D rows for human review, collect corrected semantic labels, compute inter-annotator agreement, and upgrade F-004 from surface recall to semantic-slot accuracy. This requires a human; the agent only prepares the review sheet and records the result.
tasks.done_criterion: Human-reviewed semantic summary exists with agreement recorded.
